name: Muziek maken met AI
original_description:
Turn an idea into an original song without leaving the chat. Describe the occasion, the names and the mood, or write the lyrics together with the assistant. After you confirm, Muziek maken met AI makes the song in your own muziekmakenmetai.nl account and returns two versions that play directly in the chat, with a cover and the sung lyrics.

You can also see your saved voice profiles, sing with a voice profile you recorded on the website, list your recent songs and play them again.

Made for personal songs: birthdays, retirements, weddings, a song for a pet or a joke for friends. Vocals work in Dutch, English, German and other languages.

Limits: the plugin needs a muziekmakenmetai.nl account. Editing, extending or splitting songs into stems stays in the Studio on the website. Lyrics of existing songs and imitations of named artists are refused.
